com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentSt.name: VersionName
com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentSt.description: 大版本号.强更号.VersionCode VersionCode必须大于0

com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentBo.name: BuildBundle
com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentBo.description: 是否重新打包资源，如果只是代码变动可以不打包资源。速度比较快！

com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentCh.name: HotFixMode
com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentCh.description: 运行模式(现在不允许打nativecode，只有商店包运行) NativeCode 原生模式 ILRT 热更新模式 Reflect 反射模式

com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentSt.name: LogoTime
com.gem.persistentparameter.PersistentSt.description: Logo显示时长 单个参数代表总时长 多个参数 4|2 代表单独指定每个logo时长，如果logo个数太多取最后一个时间

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS
#注意：脚本目录和xxxx.xcodeproj要在同一个目录，如果放到其他目录，请自行修改脚本。 #工程名字(Target名字) Project_Name="Unity-iPhone" #配置环境，Release或者Debug Configuration="Release"
#AdHoc版本的Bundle ID AdHocBundleID="com.igg.ios.originofconquerors" #AppStore版本的Bundle ID AppStoreBundleID="com.igg.ios.originofconquerors" #enterprise的Bundle ID EnterpriseBundleID="com.igg.ios.originofconquerors"
# ADHOC #证书名#描述文件 ADHOCCODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="iPhone Distribution: SKYUNION HONG KONG HOLDINGS LIMITED (Q5ZG592WS5)" ADHOCPROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME="7f932f23-31f1-4f0f-9dcf-be40295e0f16"
#AppStore证书名#描述文件 APPSTORECODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="iPhone Distribution: SKYUNION HONG KONG HOLDINGS LIMITED (Q5ZG592WS5)" APPSTOREROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME="61527252-58bd-4c5b-a76b-6a817e240473"
#企业(enterprise)证书名#描述文件 ENTERPRISECODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="iPhone Distribution: SKYUNION HONG KONG HOLDINGS LIMITED (Q5ZG592WS5)" ENTERPRISEROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME="4d883eee-1223-4dd9-a77a-1d667beb66f5"
#加载各个版本的plist文件 ADHOCExportOptionsPlist=${WORKSPACE}/Doc/Package/iOS/ADHOCExportOptionsPlist.plist AppStoreExportOptionsPlist=${WORKSPACE}/Doc/Package/iOS/AppStoreExportOptionsPlist.plist EnterpriseExportOptionsPlist=${WORKSPACE}/Doc/Package/iOS/EnterpriseExportOptionsPlist.plist
ADHOCExportOptionsPlist=${ADHOCExportOptionsPlist} AppStoreExportOptionsPlist=${AppStoreExportOptionsPlist} EnterpriseExportOptionsPlist=${EnterpriseExportOptionsPlist}
echo "~~~~~~~~~~~~选择打包方式(输入序号)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~" echo " 1 appstore" echo " 2 adhoc" echo " 3 enterprise"
# 读取用户输入并存到变量里 #read parameter #sleep 0.5 #method="$parameter" method=${SIGN} # 判读用户是否有输入 if [ -n "$method" ] then
#clean下 #xcodebuild clean -workspace ./$Project_Name/$Project_Name.xcworkspace -configuration $Configuration -alltargets
if [ "$method" = "1" ] then #appstore脚本 ProfType="apppstore" xcodebuild -workspace $Project_Name.xcworkspace -scheme $Project_Name -configuration $Configuration -archivePath build/$Project_Name-appstore.xcarchive clean archive build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="${APPSTORECODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" PROVISIONING_PROFILE="${APPSTOREROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME}" PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER="${AppStoreBundleID}" xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/$Project_Name-appstore.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist $AppStoreExportOptionsPlist -exportPath ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS-Ipa elif [ "$method" = "2" ] then #adhoc脚本 ProfType="adhoc" xcodebuild -workspace $Project_Name.xcworkspace -scheme $Project_Name -configuration $Configuration -archivePath build/$Project_Name-adhoc.xcarchive clean archive build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="${ADHOCCODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" PROVISIONING_PROFILE="${ADHOCPROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME}" PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER="${AdHocBundleID}" xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/$Project_Name-adhoc.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist $ADHOCExportOptionsPlist -exportPath ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS-Ipa elif [ "$method" = "3" ] then #企业打包脚本 ProfType="enterprise" xcodebuild -workspace $Project_Name.xcworkspace -scheme $Project_Name -configuration $Configuration -archivePath build/$Project_Name-enterprise.xcarchive clean archive build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="${ENTERPRISECODE_SIGN_IDENTITY}" PROVISIONING_PROFILE="${ENTERPRISEROVISIONING_PROFILE_NAME}" PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER="${EnterpriseBundleID}" xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/$Project_Name-enterprise.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist $EnterpriseExportOptionsPlist -exportPath ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS-Ipa else echo "参数无效...." exit 1 fi fi cd ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS-Ipa PackageName="iOS-${GIT_BRANCH/\//-}-v${VersionName}-b${BUILD_NUMBER}-il2cpp-${ProfType}-${HotFixMode}-"$(date "+%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S.zip") FileName="/Volumes/ssd/AOS/Packages/"${PackageName} zip -q -r -o ${FileName} './' rm -f -r ${WORKSPACE}/../Packages/iOS-Ipa SubDir=develop/iOS/ PackageDir=/Volumes/ssd/Packages/${SubDir} mkdir -p ${PackageDir} mv ${FileName} ${PackageDir}${PackageName} changeMsg="${GIT_BRANCH}:http://10.15.122.36:8088/downloadfile/${SubDir}${PackageName}?path=/${SubDir}${PackageName}" curl -d "token=d32d3affa842ec468799037636b22dac&target=group&room=10001307&title=iOS打包完成&content_type=1&content=${changeMsg}&at_user=zhongyanghuang" http://im-api.skyunion.net/msg
